technical_principle_ko: 가까운 발목을 손으로 제어하고, 한 발로 골반을 밀며, 다른 발등으로 반대 다리 뒤를 걸어 동시에 당긴다. 뒤쪽 지지가 무너져 상대 골반이 뒤로 내려가면 그립을 유지하며 상체를 따라 올린다.

key_phases.action: Show the uploaded posture and all three contacts without inventing a second visible grip.
Small coordinated weight shift; the guard's knee compresses before extension.
Extend the foot on the hip while pulling the controlled ankle and the opposite-leg hook together.
Standing partner's hips move backward and down, knees bend, limbs follow rather than translating as one rigid object.
Guard rises slightly with ankle control; release the hip foot and hook after landing, without twisting the knee.

quality_checks: Stable faces, gi colors and limb count
Continuous cloth silhouettes and no detached islands
Ankle grip and hip contact follow their targets during the force phase
No limb length changes, knee flips, teleportation or cloth holes
Visible sweep result, not only camera panning or photo wobble
No claim of instructional accuracy from schema checks alone
current_result: M4 isolated Wan Q4 trial produced three native clips; candidate-03 motion sample is ready, but exact contacts/anatomy and instructional accuracy are not passed. User quality approval pending.
